text_block_list.text:
While walking through the school after classes,
I spotted an Uma Musume dancing to music.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
One! Two! Three!
And here's the spin...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Turf... ngh――!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
――Whoops! I'm so sorry!
I almost ran right into you!
choice_data_list: I'm fine. Sorry about that on my end too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all!
I wasn't watching where I was going.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I got so caught up in the movement of my fingertips
that I let my focus slip without realizing...
choice_data_list: Detailed movements really take a lot of concentration.
Fine movements take a lot of focus, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, exactly...! As embarrassing as it is,
I've always struggled with dividing my attention between different things...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Hrmm... How can I dance
with even more delicate grace, I wonder...?
choice_data_list: Why not try speeding up the tempo of the song?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
So there are no shortcuts... I see.
Indeed, improvement without hard work is impossible!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
All right! Intense practice is the only way!
Thank you very much for your guidance!
—After that, on my way home from work...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer from earlier!
Thanks for your hard work! Are you heading home now?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I was thinking of going until right before dorm curfew!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Thanks to all the support, I've actually gotten a lot better!
choice_data_list: You're right, she really has improved...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! I've grown one step further.
I'm going to aim higher and higher!

With that refreshing smile, Narita Top Road
returned to her practice.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Huh, pick up the pace?
Why...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah, could it be?!
If I get used to a fast tempo, the original track will sound
slower, making it easier to focus...! Is that it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
That's a wonderful idea! Let's try it right away!
If you don't mind, could you clap along to the beat?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: —One! Two! Three!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Kh—whoa!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ow-ow-ow... I'm all right!

Perhaps that wasn't the best method.
Just as I was about to tell her not to push herself――

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Fufufu...! I'm getting fired up...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Once I can manage this,
I'm sure I will grow even stronger.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
However, doing it right off the bat was reckless!
I'll practice just the footwork first!
